title: What scans can and can't tell you
hook: A scanner shouts at a picture decoder and says nothing about a harmful line built at run time. Learn what a hit means, what silence means, and why neither is a verdict.

verified.claim: Every count and table in the Lab comes from a run here on samples we wrote.
ComfyUI's security policy leaves issues needing a specific custom node out of its scope.
The graph ran on a CPU.

unchecked: The samples were picked by us to show both kinds of mistake, so the counts say nothing about real packs or real scanners.
We name no scanner as good or bad, and did not test any commercial product.
How often each kind of mistake happens in the wild, which this lesson deliberately doesn't state.
